title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Multi-Agent Systems on Edge Devices
summary: Collaborative multi-agent research systems require sharing parameter updates across distributed edge workers without leaking sensitive proprietary research data. We introduce a federated optimization protocol incorporating differential privacy (epsilon=1.2, delta=1e-5) with adaptive gradient clipping. Our system maintains 96.8% model utility compared to centralized baselines while guaranteeing formal mathematical privacy against membership inference attacks.
